relations.subject: Thittila
relations.role: lecturer on the Buddhist philosophy known as Abhidhamma
relations.evidence: In 1952, Thittia returned to Myanmar to teach Abhidamma studies at the University of Yangon. Thittila at first accepted the appointment for six months or one year but wound up lecturing for eight consecutive years.

relations.subject: Thittila
relations.evidence: took part in compiling the Burmese-English dictionary, jointly working with Dr. Hla Pe

relations.subject: Thittila
relations.evidence: Just after the war, in May 1946, he participated in compiling a Burmese-English Dictionary led by Dr. Steward, along with Dr. Hla Pe.
